name: 希腊受雇工作居留许可
summary: 面向通过合资格雇主邀请或雇佣程序赴希腊从事受雇工作的第三国公民。
summaryEn: For third-country nationals entering Greece for dependent employment through the applicable employer invitation or employment procedure.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合该路径要求的工作邀请、合同或雇主申请。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer, contract or employer filing that meets the route rules is required.

qualification.summary: 仅在职位、雇主或法律要求时，须提交适用技能、资格或专业认可证明。
qualification.summaryEn: Skill, qualification or professional-recognition evidence is required only when the role, employer or law requires it.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的职位登记、劳动力市场或其他主管机关审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any vacancy-registration, labour-market or other authority assessment in force when applying must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
